messages:
Tara Ng: Heads-up — Quantix (acct: QTX-09) opened a request for a one-time onboarding credit of $45,000 and Net60 on the first three invoices. Invoice ref: INV-2026-11011. They cite extended compliance gating and cash flow timing. Need Deal Desk / finance sign-off.
Omar Lopez: Do we know if this is usage-driven or onboarding discount?
Tara Ng: Sales says it's onboarding (not accidental usage). Forecasted pilot spend ~85k over 90 days.
Jenna Kim: Legal: prefer a capped concession with clawback. We also want non-precedent language and a short amendment only.
Ethan Wells: Billing: INV-2026-11011 currently POSTED 2265430000. We can apply credit reversal but need explicit Deal Desk approval and signed amendment uploaded.
BillingBot: System: INV-2026-11011 status: POSTED. Ticket created: BILL-1168.
Omar Lopez: Finance perspective: $45k is large. Propose $20k credit + Net45 for pilot AND require either escrowed PO or bank guarantee for Net60 requests.
Ravi Desai: CFO here  I can approve $20k one-time credit and Net45. Conditional: 1) signed amendment with clawback, 2) credit applied after milestone confirmation, 3) no change to pricing or future terms. If Quantix converts to Dedicated within 180 days, consider an additional $5k conversion credit.
Jenna Kim: Draft amendment snippet: ```Amendment: Redwood Inference will grant Customer a one-time onboarding credit of $20,000 applied to invoice INV-2026-11011 upon execution of this amendment and verification of onboarding milestone completion. Payment terms for pilot invoices shall be Net45. This concession is a one-time, non-precedential accommodation and shall not be construed as an amendment to Redwood Inference's standard pricing. In the event Customer converts to Redwood Dedicated within 180 days, Redwood may apply an additional $5,000 conversion credit.```
Ethan Wells: Billing ticket BILL-1168 updated; awaiting signed amendment PDF upload for credit processing.
Tara Ng: I'll present $20k + Net45 + $5k conversion incentive to Quantix; will ask for bank guarantee if they insist on Net60.
Ravi Desai: Approved in Deal Desk. Left note in DEAL-4091 and cc'd finance-approvals@redwood.com.
Tara Ng: Thanks all  moving to close unless customer pushes for more.
